Amazon EVS launches support for r7i.metal instances, external principal storage, and an Agent Skill
changes.detail: Today, we are announcing that Amazon Elastic VMware Service (Amazon EVS) now supports the r7i.metal-24xl and r7i.metal-48xl Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) bare metal instance types for VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) 9.x deployments. EC2 r7i instances are memory optimized, with custom 4th Generation Intel Xeon Scalable (Sapphire Rapids) processors, and designed to be used with external storage. changes.title: AWS Lambda durable functions now supports pausing and deleting executions
changes.detail: AWS Lambda durable functions now lets you pause a running durable execution and resume it later without losing its progress. When you resume an execution, it continues from its last checkpoint on the same function version. By default, time spent paused doesn't count toward the execution timeout. You can also now delete a completed execution's data before its retention period ends. With Lambda durable functions, you can build resilient multi-step applications and AI workflows that run for up to one year, with built-in checkpointing and automatic retries. changes.title: AWS Workload Credentials Provider adds container support for ACM certificates
changes.detail: The open source AWS Workload Credentials Provider can now export AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificates to applications running in containers on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), including AWS Fargate, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), and Docker on Amazon EC2. You can now automate certificate deployment and renewal for containerized TLS workloads the same way you do on EC2 instances, on both Linux and Windows.
